question: Find the IDs of players who scored the highest number of partnership runs for each match. The output should include the IDs of two players, each with their individual scores and the total partnership score. For each pair, the player with the higher individual score should be listed as player 1, and the player with the lower score as player 2. In cases where both players have the same score, the player with the higher ID should be player 1, and the player with the lower ID should be player 2. There can be multiple rows for a single match.
sql:
-- Count total rows in our result
WITH partnership_runs AS (
    SELECT b.match_id,
           CASE WHEN b.striker < b.non_striker THEN b.striker ELSE b.non_striker END as p1, 
           CASE WHEN b.striker < b.non_striker THEN b.non_striker ELSE b.striker END as p2,
           CAST(SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) AS BIGINT) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.match_id, p1, p2
),
best_partnership AS (
    SELECT match_id, p1, p2, total_runs
    FROM (
        SELECT match_id, p1, p2, total_runs,
               DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC) as drnk
        FROM partnership_runs
    )
    WHERE drnk = 1
),
ball_with_pair AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.striker, b.non_striker,
           CAST(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) AS BIGINT) as runs_scored,
           CASE WHEN b.striker < b.non_striker THEN b.striker ELSE b.non_striker END as p1,
           CASE WHEN b.striker < b.non_striker THEN b.non_striker ELSE b.striker END as p2
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE (b.match_id, 
           CASE WHEN b.striker < b.non_striker THEN b.striker ELSE b.non_striker END,
           CASE WHEN b.striker < b.non_striker THEN b.non_striker ELSE b.striker END) 
           IN (SELECT match_id, p1, p2 FROM best_partnership)
),
individual_runs AS (
    SELECT match_id, p1, p2,
           CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN striker = p1 THEN runs_scored ELSE 0 END) AS BIGINT) as p1_runs,
           CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN striker = p2 THEN runs_scored ELSE 0 END) AS BIGINT) as p2_runs
    FROM ball_with_pair
    GROUP BY match_id, p1, p2
),
ordered AS (
    SELECT bp.match_id,
           CASE WHEN ir.p1_runs > ir.p2_runs THEN ir.p1 
                WHEN ir.p2_runs > ir.p1_runs THEN ir.p2
                ELSE GREATEST(ir.p1, ir.p2) END as player1_id,
           CASE WHEN ir.p1_runs > ir.p2_runs THEN ir.p2 
                WHEN ir.p2_runs > ir.p1_runs THEN ir.p1
                ELSE LEAST(ir.p1, ir.p2) END as player2_id,
           CASE WHEN ir.p1_runs > ir.p2_runs THEN ir.p1_runs 
                WHEN ir.p2_runs > ir.p1_runs THEN ir.p2_runs
                ELSE GREATEST(ir.p1_runs, ir.p2_runs) END as player1_score,
           CASE WHEN ir.p1_runs > ir.p2_runs THEN ir.p2_runs 
                WHEN ir.p2_runs > ir.p1_runs THEN ir.p1_runs
                ELSE LEAST(ir.p1_runs, ir.p2_runs) END as player2_score,
           bp.total_runs as partnership_score
    FROM best_partnership bp
    JOIN individual_runs ir ON bp.match_id = ir.match_id AND bp.p1 = ir.p1 AND bp.p2 = ir.p2
)
